observed_failure.systemd: Gateway Type=notify exited before readiness and entered automatic restart with result protocol.
observed_failure.mechanism: The host rendezvous liveness check compared Linux boot-relative ticks under a 200-tick tolerance. Across boots the unrelated process differed by only 98 ticks, and the old record was treated as an owner whose served set was pending. The record timestamps predated the current boot.

remaining: Repair and qualify the persistent cross-boot owner predicate in source and installed workflow. Reconcile each future runtime admission against the then-current boot and process identity. The one-time recovery does not qualify the prevention fix.
